subject: regional-sanskrit
title: Sanskrit — Set 3
description: Week 23 — animals, body parts & family words

questions.question: What does 'गजः' (Gajah) mean?
questions.explanation: 'गजः' means elephant in Sanskrit. 'हस्ती' is another word for elephant.

questions.question: What does 'जलम्' (Jalam) mean?
questions.explanation: 'जलम्' means water in Sanskrit. 'अपः' and 'वारि' also mean water.

questions.question: What does 'हस्तः' (Hastah) mean?
questions.explanation: 'हस्तः' means hand in Sanskrit. 'करः' also means hand.

questions.question: What does 'सूर्यः' (Suryah) mean?
questions.explanation: 'सूर्यः' means sun in Sanskrit. 'रविः' and 'भानुः' also mean sun.

questions.question: What does 'माता' (Mata) mean?
questions.explanation: 'माता' means mother in Sanskrit. 'जननी' also means mother.

questions.question: What does 'पिता' (Pita) mean?
questions.explanation: 'पिता' means father in Sanskrit. 'जनकः' also means father.

questions.question: What does 'वृक्षः' (Vrikshah) mean?
questions.explanation: 'वृक्षः' means tree in Sanskrit. 'तरुः' also means tree.

questions.question: What does 'पुष्पम्' (Pushpam) mean?
questions.explanation: 'पुष्पम्' means flower in Sanskrit. 'सुमनम्' also means flower.
